display_name: Phase1 源样本旧恢复器与 Tri-SIG-TIME 一致性诊断
description: 仅重用 Phase1 源训练记录的原始接收和旧恢复器原始输出，以原 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL 比较对 clean 基座判断的保留程度。
authorization: 用户要求研发更强星地恢复网络并严格限定 Phase1 地面训练、测试与 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL 基座。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI Python/Torch CPU only, original Phase1 frozen Tri-SIG-TIME release

data.representation: Phase1 R07 source clean/received and existing original DURA native IQ, aligned source positions only
data.label_map_ref: Phase1 six TX classes; hidden throughout restorer training
data.tx_sets_ref: Six original classes; no TX labels in restorer training
data.validation_ref: Existing complete R07 source cache, IDs compared with Tri-SIG-TIME source contract
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 original fixed cross_rx126000 and cross_both42000; no support
data.leo_config_ref: R07 2.462 GHz source views and Phase1 six fixed practical test views
data.actual_training_labels: No training and no TX labels, V or test IQ

permissions.regime: Phase1 source L_s/U_s and frozen original Tri-SIG-TIME SSL only
permissions.claim_scope: Source label-free consistency, not accuracy or target performance

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen Phase1 Tri-SIG-TIME E50 and existing frozen original Phase1 DURA native source IQ
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Pinned source producer launch, exact 128 L +384 U deterministic positions, role IDs and clean arrays
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Phase1-only source outputs; no old classifier decisions consumed
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed source records/views, no optimization or output-based selection

execution.gpu_policy: CPU2/0GPU, true source checkpoint smoke before launch
execution.stop_rule: Input contract mismatch, nonfinite output, insufficient stratum or output collision: preserve evidence, no automatic retry

dimensions: source views 01/20, 512 fixed L_s/U_s physical IDs
metrics_plan.targets_ref: source diagnostic only, no target performance claim

notes: 源记录固定 512 个唯一物理 ID（L128/U384），R07 源视图 01/20 共 1024 条观测；配对 clean/roles/物理 ID 与 Phase1 原缓存逐项比对。
只从旧源档案惰性读取原 DURA native IQ、clean、源 ID/role/scene/state，严格不读取旧 F 输出、对齐波形或辅助分析结果。
对 clean、raw 和原 DURA IQ 全部重新用冻结的 Tri-SIG-TIME 计算特征和分类分布；一致率以 clean F 判断为参照，不是真实 TX 准确率。
不访问 V、测试 IQ 或 TX 真值，所有网络零更新；该诊断仅为后续源数据候选提供机制证据，不更改已登记运行候选。

rows.method: Frozen DURA native source IQ and frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL
rows.purpose: Evaluate source-semantic case for DURA-anchored generative flow
rows.seed_notes: Fixed existing source positions and views; no stochastic sampling
rows.budget_ref: 512 unique source rows x two received views x clean/raw/native frozen reader passes
